$comment: #VAPP-185 (epic VAPP-175, owner 2026-10-31): Settings › MCP, ONE page ×4 (web routes/t/$teamSlug/settings/mcp.tsx, desktop crates/ui/src/settings/mcp.rs, iOS McpSettingsPage.swift, Android McpSettingsScreen.kt), the SAME look everywhere: existing components only (glass groups of rows, the section label above each group, Pill, the Picker, Button, SegmentedControl, the Prompt). It REPLACES the MCP servers page: the settings-nav row `mcp` (label `title`) on every platform, phones included; the old web route `/settings/mcp-servers` redirects to `/settings/mcp` keeping its query (`?connect=`, the OAuth callback's `?mcp=…&server=`). SECTIONS in `sections` order, each a label over one glass group (no explanatory subtitles): (1) ENDPOINT: one row, the global apps endpoint `<instance>/api/mcp/apps` in mono (truncated in the middle on phones) + a `copy` button (the platform's copy + the `copied` toast). (2) SERVERS: today's MCP servers rows unchanged (name, Default pill, host; the viewer's ONE action: Connect / Set key / Reconnect / a Connected caption; the … menu), each row's caption gains `usedBy` naming the apps (alphabetical, by name) whose head package declares the server in `upstreams` (`usedByCases`); owners add / edit / remove as today. Phones (no add/edit there) show the rows and the member's own Connect / Disconnect. (3) CLIENTS: the MCP clients (OAuth clients a member authorized: tRPC `mcpClients.list {teamId, scope}`); owners see a SegmentedControl `scopes` (Mine | Everyone) above the group, members only Mine and no control. A row = the client's name (its icon when it has one, else the concept `settings-mcp`), caption = `clientCaption` (`clientCaptionCases`: Everyone prefixes the member's name; the kinds, `builtin` first; the apps grant's access; `lastUsed` = the compact list relative time (`just now · 5m · 2h · 3d`) or `never`), trailing a `revoke` button (outline, small) asking the prompts.json `revoke-mcp-client` prompt; a member revokes only their own, an owner anyone's in Everyone. Empty = empty-state.json `mcp-clients`. (4) ACCESS (only when the team has an app exposing tools): ONE glass group PER APP (alphabetical by name; its header row = the app's glyph + name + `toolCount` caption), rows = the members (owners: every member, by name; a member: only their own row), each with the avatar, the name and the level: owners pick it with THE Picker over `levels` (labels in order), members read the label. Below the groups one row `activity` (chevron) opens the ACTIVITY page. (5) BUILT-IN: the existing built-in Exponential tools group (label `builtin`, its filter), unchanged, last. ACTIVITY (`activityPage`, its own page, title `activity`, back to MCP): the `mcp_calls` rows newest first (tRPC `mcpActivity.list {teamId}`; owners: the team's calls, a member: their own; 90 days), a row = the tool name in mono, caption = `activityCaption` (`activityCaptionCases`: the app's name or `builtinApp`, the member (owners only), the client or `firstParty`, the compact relative time), trailing a Pill with the `statusLabels` word of its status. Empty = empty-state.json `mcp-activity`. `testIds` = the anchors every client's capture and test use.
